    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # Fix island case variant
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'biscoe': 'Biscoe'})
    # Fix body_mass_g: remove commas and convert to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix out-of-range value: 3650000 appears to be in mg, convert to g
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
